description: An exterior twilight shot of a modern residential garage facade rendered in smooth white stucco with a flat roofline and clean horizontal lines. The overhead garage door is retracted fully open, revealing a silver luxury sports car parked inside on a smooth concrete floor, its hood and headlights facing outward toward the camera. The driveway in the foreground is a broad expanse of light-toned concrete. The surrounding sky has deepened to a rich dusk blue-grey gradient, with a sliver of fading orange on the horizon visible behind neighboring rooftops at the far right. The stucco facade is warm and slightly textured under the glow cast symmetrically from two vertical warm-toned light sources flanking the garage opening — their illumination washing the stucco surface in amber columns and creating a welcoming, hotel-like presence at the entry. The architecture is minimal with no ornamentation beyond the crisp overhang edge. Camera is positioned at standing eye-level, roughly centered on the garage opening with a normal-to-slightly-wide lens, giving a centered symmetrical composition that balances the facade evenly on both sides of the open bay. The framing includes the full width of the stucco wall, the driveway apron, and the sky above the roofline. The scene reads as sophisticated and quiet, a residential exterior lit against a dramatic dusk sky.
